question: With the palm against an upright cylinder of diameter D, can the thumb and the fingers reach far enough around it to oppose the palm's push? (kinematics only)
change_from_v2: the cylinder axis sits at the radius-consistent grasp pose, palm-frame (0.077, r + 0.015), instead of being slid along the palm normal through the palm centre until it touches the palm; phi 0 is therefore the cylinder point facing the palm (there is no palm contact point to start from). Everything else as in v2; v2's anchor_sensitivity is not repeated.

method.model: TableScene(0.74, cup_model='mug') from sim/scene.py: the sim's compiled model (URDF g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0, same collision geoms and pairs); its body cylinder 'cup_geom' is resized per D, the handle geoms are never queried; only finger joints are set; mj_kinematics + mj_geomDistance (signed, convex hulls); no time stepping
method.palm_frame: right_hand_palm_link (origin = HERO palm point = wrist_yaw_link + (0.0415, -0.003, 0)); x along the fingers, z = finger hinge axis (index +z, middle -z), +y = palm side
method.palm_normal: +y of the palm frame: the side the fingers flex toward; the palm mesh's thinnest principal axis is 3.21 deg from it
method.palm_side_max_y_note: largest palm-frame y of the palm geom and of the thumb's base link geom (all joints 0): the thumb base stands out above the palm face, next to the palm normal
method.grasp_height: palm origin 0.065 m above the table (sim/pick_place.py GRASP_Z_ABOVE_TABLE); cylinder base on the table; cylinder height = config height_m = 0.091 m for every D
method.diameters_note: 60-110 mm in 5 mm steps + the M1 cylinder's 80 mm (sim/scene.py CUP_RADIUS x 2; already on the grid; height 0.091 m like every D, not the M1 cylinder's 0.10 m: this row varies the diameter only) + 99 mm (mug label)
method.grid: 21 values per joint, np.linspace over the joint range (ends included); other digits at 0. phi_max is a lower bound of the continuous maximum (a finer grid containing this one can only raise it); joint steps are range / 20 (4.5-6 deg)

thumb.positive_phi: clockwise about palm +z (thumb curls from +y toward +x)

index.positive_phi: counter-clockwise about palm +z (fingers flex from +x toward +y)

middle.positive_phi: counter-clockwise about palm +z (fingers flex from +x toward +y)

method.touch: fingertip geom distance in [0, 3] mm AND every collision geom of the digit >= -1 mm
method.closest_point_surface: side / top cap / bottom cap, or 'top rim edge' / 'bottom rim edge' when the point is at radius r AND at a cap height (within 0.1 mm)
method.verdict: comfortable if both maxima >= 90 deg; marginal if both >= 90 - atan(mu); infeasible otherwise (a digit with no touching configuration counts as infeasible)
method.cylinder_axis: parallel to palm z (= world up in the oracle's side grasp), at palm-frame (x, y) = radius_consistent_offset(r)[:2] = (0.077, r + 0.015) (sim/pick_place.py; the oracle's GRASP_OFFSET with its palm-normal component made r + 0.015, exactly GRASP_OFFSET at r = 0.040); nothing slides, the palm may touch or overlap the cylinder (palm_geom_distance_mm per row, information only)
method.phi: angle about the cylinder axis of the fingertip's closest point on the cylinder (mj_geomDistance fromto), from the cylinder point facing the palm (0 deg: the surface point straight back from the axis along the palm normal, palm -y), positive toward the digit's own side (fixed per digit by the hand, WRAP_SIGN), wrapped to [-180, 180]

mu.source: model.pair_friction[0] of the explicit pairs cup_geom x fingertip geom in the compiled scene (sim/scene.py: CUP_FRICTION['hand'] = HERO's glazed-ceramic prior); explicit pairs replace the geoms' max-friction mixing (hand geoms 1.5, cup 0.35)
mu.contact_check: each fingertip at its 99 mm argmax configuration pushed 0.5 mm into the cylinder, mj_forward, all contacts between that fingertip geom and the cylinder (digits without a touching configuration: none)

pyramidal_cone_info.note: information only, not used: MuJoCo's pyramidal cone is inscribed in the friction cone, so between its edges the tangential limit drops to mu/sqrt(2)

cylinder.axis_source: sim/pick_place.py radius_consistent_offset(r) = (GRASP_OFFSET x, r + 0.015, GRASP_OFFSET z) + the centre's height
